questions.q: In the four-task job example, what does Task 2 represent?
options: Chapter 3's declarative pipeline, run as a single Pipeline task
Chapter 2's Auto Loader ingestion
A manual notebook-based cleanup step
The job's retry policy configuration
questions.explain: Task 2 runs the entire Lakeflow Declarative Pipeline from Chapter 3 as one step, exactly as Lesson 54 first showed.

questions.q: What makes Task 4 (send_failure_alert) only run when Task 2 fails, instead of every time?
options: Its Run if condition is set to "At least one failed"
It has no depends_on entry at all
It runs on a completely separate, unrelated job
It uses the same cluster as Task 1
questions.explain: The Run if: At least one failed condition means Task 4 only fires when its dependency (Task 2) actually fails.

questions.q: Why do Task 3 and Task 4 represent a real fan-out pattern, per this lesson?
options: Both depend on the same upstream task (Task 2), but with different Run if conditions for happy-path vs. failure-path
They both run on the same job cluster
They both ingest the same raw files
Neither task actually depends on Task 2
questions.explain: Task 3 and Task 4 both depend on Task 2, but diverge based on different Run if conditions — the fan-out this lesson describes.

questions.q: According to this lesson, what is orchestration's real role in this full pipeline?
options: Tying ingestion, transformation, and serving into one unattended, end-to-end job — not a fourth new concept
Replacing the need for Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines entirely
Only scheduling notebook runs, nothing else
Providing a new way to write PySpark transformations
questions.explain: Neither Chapter 2 nor Chapter 3 alone explained how a new file becomes a refreshed dashboard end to end — that's what Job orchestration does.

questions.q: What does Chapter 5, coming next, cover according to this lesson's close?
options: Performance at Scale — the Photon engine, adaptive query execution, caching, cluster sizing, and cost optimization
Unity Catalog access control
Delta Sharing between organizations
DP-750 exam prep
questions.explain: Chapter 5, Performance at Scale, picks up next, making everything this job runs faster and cheaper.
